title: DigiEmu P0 Intent Envelope v0.1
description: Normalized request envelope before architectural Admission. This envelope captures the intended capability, aggregate, and command without claiming verification success, runtime enforcement, or external authority approval.

schema_version.description: Version of the Intent Envelope schema.

architecture_revision.description: Revision of the authoritative architecture baseline. This field references architecture-baseline.yaml: baseline.revision. The current authoritative revision is "0.3".

intent_id.description: Unique identifier for this intent. The exact deterministic derivation rule for intent_id is not yet defined; it MUST NOT be assumed to be random, UUID-generated, or produced by any non-deterministic process.

capability_ref.description: Reference to a capability defined in core-capability-registry.yaml.

aggregate_ref.description: Reference to the aggregate owner responsible for the target of the intent, as defined in aggregate-ownership-registry.yaml.

command_ref.description: Reference to the architectural command being requested, as defined in command-event-catalogue.yaml.

payload.description: Command-specific payload. The exact schema for each payload is not defined in this envelope; it is interpreted by the target command handler.
